personas.name: Abuela Carmen
personas.title: card stall at El Rastro, since 1985
personas.bio: Carmen has sold cards from the same folding table at El Rastro every Sunday for forty years. She knows every child who ever swapped a duplicate there and most of their grandchildren.

personas.name: El Chato
personas.title: Rastro regular, silver packs and rare singles
personas.bio: Nobody knows his real name. He has worked the stall next to Abuela Carmen for twenty years, knows the price of every card in Madrid, and has a long memory for people who try to be clever.

personas.name: Doña Pilar
personas.title: collector from Salamanca, buys what completes her albums

levels.name: El Chato
levels.teaser: «Better packs, friendly prices. If I like you.»
levels.how: Better packs and rare singles; he buys uncommon and rare cards. Open a thread with him (with: chato).

levels.name: Doña Pilar
levels.teaser: «I collect what others throw away.»
levels.how: A collector: she pays over book for the cards she loves and sells gold packs. Open a thread with her (with: pilar).

levels.name: Los Pícaros
levels.teaser: «Quick deals. Few questions.»
levels.how: Two brothers with bargains and bad faith: read every offer before you accept, and flag a trick (POST /api/flags).

levels.name: The Workshop
levels.teaser: «Three spares. One surprise.»
levels.how: POST /api/taller {"assets": [a, b, c]}: three spare copies of one rarity (you keep at least one of each card) become one card of the next rarity. The pull is luck, shown and never scored.

levels.name: Radio Rastro
levels.teaser: «At El Rastro you hear everything. Some of it is true.»
levels.how: News on air: GET /api/news (newest first; also news.posted on the live stream). Three sources: the Boletín del Bazar (the Bazaar bulletin), Radio Rastro and El Tablón, the notice board. Some items are true and the market moves as they say; some are rumours that never happen; some are just Madrid. Nothing tells you which is which.

personas.name: Abuela Carmen
personas.title: card stall at El Rastro, since 1985
personas.bio: Carmen has sold cards from the same folding table at El Rastro every Sunday for forty years. She knows every child who ever swapped a duplicate there and most of their grandchildren.

personas.name: El Chato
personas.title: Rastro regular, silver packs and rare singles
personas.bio: Nobody knows his real name. He has worked the stall next to Abuela Carmen for twenty years, knows the price of every card in Madrid, and has a long memory for people who try to be clever.

personas.name: Doña Pilar
personas.title: collector from Salamanca, buys what completes her albums
personas.bio: Pilar has collected cards since the 1960s and keeps her albums in a safe. She pays very well for the cards she loves and looks down on everything else. She also sells gold packs to people she considers serious.

personas.name: Los Pícaros
personas.title: Paco and Nando, twin brothers with a suitcase full of bargains
personas.bio: Paco and Nando appear wherever there is money and disappear before anyone checks the cards. Their bargains are sometimes real. Their deadlines never are.
